note: Context for the AI page. Valuations are as reported by the named press or law-firm source on the date shown, are not from company filings, and are unverified. They are the value at the last priced round or announcement, not a market capitalization. A company with no valuation here had no figure corroborated by two or more independent sources when this list was reviewed.

companies.name: OpenAI
companies.what: Developer of ChatGPT and the GPT models.
companies.basis: post-money valuation after a $122 billion funding round that closed on 2026-03-31
companies.status_note: Reported to have filed confidentially with the SEC for an IPO in 2026, with timing undecided; a later report says it is weighing an IPO as soon as 2027.

companies.name: Anthropic (Claude)
companies.basis: valuation including new money in a $65 billion Series H reported in late May 2026
companies.status_note: Reported to have filed confidentially with the SEC on 2026-06-01; no listing date was announced in the cited reports.

companies.name: Databricks
companies.what: Data and AI platform for enterprises.
companies.basis: valuation announced with a $5 billion round on 2026-08-13 (an earlier term-sheet report said $188 billion)

companies.name: Mistral AI
companies.what: French developer of open-weight and commercial language models.
companies.basis: post-money valuation of more than 21 billion euros in a 3 billion euro Series D reported in September 2026

companies.name: xAI
companies.no_valuation_reason: Reported to have been acquired by SpaceX in February 2026 (about $250 billion in that deal, per anonymous sources), so it has no separate valuation. SpaceX (SPCX) reportedly listed on Nasdaq on 2026-06-12 and is in the ranked AI universe.

companies.name: Perplexity
companies.no_valuation_reason: Reports of an early-2026 valuation near $20 billion and of talks above $30 billion are not corroborated by two independent sources.

companies.name: Safe Superintelligence
companies.what: Research lab co-founded by Ilya Sutskever.
companies.no_valuation_reason: The most-cited figure ($32 billion, April 2025) is more than a year old, and reports of later rounds conflict.

companies.name: Thinking Machines Lab
companies.what: AI research lab led by Mira Murati.
companies.no_valuation_reason: Reports of a 2026 round at a much higher valuation than its 2025 seed conflict with mainstream reporting.

companies.name: Anysphere (Cursor)
companies.what: Maker of the Cursor AI coding tool.
companies.no_valuation_reason: Reports of a 2026 round and of a SpaceX purchase offer conflict on how the round ended.

companies.name: Scale AI
companies.what: Data and evaluation services for AI developers.

companies.name: Lambda
companies.what: GPU cloud for AI training and inference.
companies.no_valuation_reason: Reported to be weighing a private round and a possible later IPO; neither is confirmed.

companies.name: Crusoe
companies.no_valuation_reason: Reported to be private and evaluating its options; no current valuation was corroborated.
